scope: bounded exhaustion of the compact-Yang-Mills, broken-Spin(2,3)-action, real-form, shared-scale and weak-field route families opened by claims 1590-1594
positive_results: exact reflection-positive compact finite transfer systems and certified finite Hamiltonian/loop/moment bounds
a healthy massless-graviton plus massive-pseudoscalar critical Poincare-gauge sector as a classical theory or EFT
an explicit radiative selector portal deriving Spin23-breaking, Planck, curvature and colored-threshold relations from one vev
a conditional interacting gauge-gravity fixed point that makes the color coupling irrelevant

an exact observable separation: unpolarized frame dragging is GR while polarized sources can exchange torsion
exact_no_gos: naive compact-to-noncompact analytic continuation fails reflection positivity
minimal MacDowell-Mansouri plus torsion-square terms creates no propagating massive connection pole

irreducible_open_gates.need: a nontrivial reflection-positive four-dimensional continuum Yang-Mills construction with a regulator- and volume-uniform positive physical spectral bound
a symmetry-protected radiatively closed nonlinear completion of the healthy critical gravitational sector, derived from a complete broken Spin23 parent
a nonperturbatively established Spin23 gauge-gravity universality class with an irrelevant color direction and observable matching

stop_rule: Within the declared local polynomial actions, finite regulators, listed deformation methods, fixed-point ansatzes and portal field content, every route now ends in a positive construction, an explicit counterexample/no-go, or one of five named gates. Further progress requires new infinite-dimensional estimates, a new UV parent/symmetry, or new empirical input; renaming or rescanning the same finite structures is not progress.
not_claimed: exhaustion of all future mathematics, all possible field content or the Clay Yang-Mills problem
